paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness plugin: connect a self-hosted Magpie gateway with one real provider route per upstr

model visibility, default effort and per-session fast mode
# dsh-magpie-connector
English · 简体中文
*Top: model picker grouped by upstream provider. Middle: Settings → Magpie — the connection line, th
e sidebar usage panel (toggle plus auto-refresh interval in minutes) and per-provider model visibili
ty, default effort and usage cards. Bottom: the resident sidebar usage card (click its header to exp
and every window). Captured from an isolated DSH host (English UI) with a local mock Magpie gateway;
gateway address, models, account and readings are synthetic.*
**Connect a self-hosted Magpie gateway to DeepSeek Harness with one provider route per upstream owne
r: models grouped by upstream provider on stock DSH, usage cards (you can spend a Codex reset from t
hem), and a per-session fast mode.** Magpie keeps managing logins, accounts, routing and provider eg
ress; this plugin adds the DSH side.
### What you get
| Capability | What it does |
| **Gateway lines** (basic) | Each line has its own URL and gateway key. The model catalog comes fro
m the gateway's `GET /models`; Responses-capable models use Responses, everything else uses Chat Com
pletions. Text, tool round trips, images, usage, cancellation and DSH-managed retries go through. |
| **Check a line before saving** (0.4.0) | Every line card has “Check line”: one real `GET /models`
with that card's address, access mode and key (empty credentials fall back to the line's saved value
s), rendered as a read-only snapshot — result kind, latency, model count and, when the host has a ca
ched catalog with a sync time, the model ids extra to or missing from that cache. It never changes t
he active line, writes credentials/settings, syncs the catalog or registers a route; the diff is aga

inst the *cached* catalog, so it never claims to match the current line. |
| **Automatic multi-line
failover** (signature) | Empty on first install; normally one line; add backup lines and let the ord
er decide priority. Before every gateway operation the plugin picks the first reachable complete lin
e with a ≤600ms TCP probe (10s positive / 15s negative in-memory cache, no background polling), so h
ome uses the LAN while outside falls back to the public endpoint. Switching lines carries the catalo
g over (no flash), clears usage cards and re-syncs the new line; single-line users keep 0.1.x behavi

or. |
| **Grouped by upstream provider** (signature) | Works on stock DSH, no Host extension needed:
the plugin registers one real provider route per gateway `owned_by` (`dsh-magpie-connector-claude`,
`-codex`, `-opencode-go`, …; missing or invalid ownership goes to `-other`), so the official model
picker shows `Magpie (Claude)`, `Magpie (Codex)`, `Magpie (Opencode-go)`, `Magpie (Other)` groups. S
ettings and usage cards use the same grouping, and a provider that only appears in usage is never dr

cards use the same grouping, and a provider that only appears in usage is never dropped. |
[该节后续省略]
### Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart DSH and refresh the Web page. Inside ohmydsh you can instead enable the local `dsh-magpie-co
nnector` manifest entry and rebuild. Tested with DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`, Web UI, Node.js `>=22.19`.
> **0.3.0 BREAKING upgrade**: the single `dsh-magpie-connector` route is retired. Sessions and the d
efault model saved on it no longer resolve; pick the model again from a `Magpie (…)` group. Routes t
hat depend on the exact route id elsewhere (e.g. subagent routing, egress allowlists) must list the
new `dsh-magpie-connector-<owner>` ids.
### Configure
Open **Settings → Magpie**.
1. In **line 1**, enter the gateway API URL **including `/v1`**, for example `http://192.168.1.20:34
25/v1`, and that line's gateway key. The line list, addresses, visibility and default efforts live a
t `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-magpie-connector/settings.json` — keys and Access values are never written

there or returned by the settings API.
2. For multiple ingresses press **Add backup line**; each lin
e has its own address and key. Use the move-up/move-down buttons to change priority (number 1 wins).
Saving keeps only the active line expanded; the 4×4 green marker after its number shows the current

line, and the info icon explains priority and automatic fallback.
3. Inside each line's **Advanced
connection** choose Direct or Cloudflare Access. LAN and Tailscale are Direct; Cloudflare Access req
uires an HTTPS line and switching back to Direct clears that line's two Access credentials on save.

Cloudflare Free/Pro returns 524 when the origin sends nothing for 100 seconds.
4. Saving synchronize
s the catalog; **Refresh model list** synchronizes again, and there is no catalog polling.
> **0.2.0 BREAKING upgrade**: settings are now a single `lines[]` format. A legacy single-address `s
ettings.json` (top-level `baseUrl`) and the legacy fixed credential refs (`MAGPIE_API_KEY` / `MAGPIE
_ACCESS_*`) are **not read or migrated**; re-add your lines and enter each line's key/Access in Sett
ings. Model visibility and default efforts are preserved; old credential records can be deleted manu
ally in DSH credentials. Back up `settings.json` and the old refs first if you want to keep a rollba
DSH credentials. Back up `settings.json` and the old refs first if you want to keep a rollback path.
Need another method — custom headers, mTLS, another zero-trust gateway? **Issues and pull requests a
re welcome**; describe your deployment and the gateway version.
### Where things happen
| Where | What you do |
| **Model picker** | Search across group headings, model names and full ids. Each group is a real ro
ute `dsh-magpie-connector-<owner>`; model ids stay the gateway's full ids, and visibility keys and d

efault effort are unchanged. |
[该节后续省略]
### Spending a reset
**Usage limit resets** folds out every credit the account holds. Only the credit that expires first
carries **Use…**: it stays inert until the weekly window reaches 80%, and confirming spends that one
after the two-step check. Expiry times are right-aligned and the rows line up with the section titl
fter the two-step check. Expiry times are right-aligned and the rows line up with the section title.
